final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS ref, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS ga, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS a2 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref, s1.ga, s1.cnt, s1.ga - s2.a2 AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a2 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.ga > s2.a2) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s3
